description: Eerste Helmersstraat 41-57 (1910-11): 5.9 m dark red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a brick dentil cornice at 15.3 m; three axes of tall windows with a small-pane top light under flat brick lintels, white frames and sills; an iron-railed balcony on a bracketed slab on the centre axis of storeys 1-3; a brick wall dormer over the centre axis with one wide light and a flat cap, a small dormer beside it

wall-dormer.note: 41-57: a brick wall dormer over the centre axis rising 2.1 m over the cornice, one wide light, flat cap

door-right.note: 49: double house door with a fanlight on the right axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 windows with a small-pane top light, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; doors pair at the party walls
rhythm.roofline: brick dentil cornice at 15.3 m; a brick wall dormer on the centre axis

match.note: Eerste Helmersstraat 41-57 (1910-11), 5.8-6.5 m; cornice 15.3 m on the 2023-01-12 strip
